claim: Indian steel/metal stocks rallied Nov 2022; cause China reopening hopes and/or removal of steel export duty ~19 Nov 2022
verified_detail: Nifty Metal rose 11.3% in Nov 2022 (5896.35 on 31 Oct -> 6564.20 on 30 Nov; computed from Yahoo, matches IIFL 'added 11.00% over last one month'). Most of the rally came BEFORE the duty removal: index was 6589.55 on 15 Nov (+11.8% vs 31 Oct); 4 Nov alone was +4.21%. China easing/zero-Covid-exit hopes (second week of Nov) is the commonly cited driver, but I could only support it from search-result snippets/secondary commentary (the articles I fetched on China easing were dated Dec 2022). Export duty: govt notification late Fri 18 Nov 2022, effective 19 Nov, scrapped duties on pig iron, steel products, pellets; cut iron-ore duty. Market reaction was mixed: on Mon 21 Nov small steel names jumped (GPIL +19%, SAIL, Jindal Stainless up) but Nifty Metal FELL 0.81% as heavyweights (Tata Steel, JSW, Hindalco, JSPL) lagged. So the duty removal was NOT the cause of the overall Nov rally; it boosted a few names.
source_quote: SteelOrbis: 'according to a government notification late on Friday, November 18'. IIFL (21 Nov 2022): steel shares rallied, 'rising up to 19% on Monday'; GPIL 'increased 19% to Rs 323.80 per share'; Sensex 'was down 0.82 % at 61,151'. IIFL (4 Nov 2022): 'Nifty Metal index ended up 4.21% at 6324.15 today.'
